notes.title: Platypus Reclayed is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Platypus is back 23 years later from the Original Developer Anthony Flack!
You can play Platypus Reclayed NOW on PC, Mac, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch

[previewyoutube="Qq4fCHFMKTg;full"][/previewyoutube]

23 years after its first appearance, led by the original creator Anthony Flack alongside the Claymatic team, Platypus Reclayed isn't just a simple remaster - it's a complete revamp: 


Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware.. 

Platypus Reclayed is moulded from the ground up with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. 



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2912430/Platypus_Reclayed/"][/dynamiclink]

Experience claytastic arcade style mayhem with engrossing retro vibes - The cult shoot-em-up Platypus is back in all its clayful glory. 👏


Modding | Community-made fun!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6593986/43d5a3a2008d7f434389c5083a7da650d7d2907f.png"]



We loved the mods and fan art you made for the original game - This time, we've got your back.

We've made Platypus Reclayed with the intent of allowing you to create your own custom-made mods - Visit our Modding Guide!

BLAST-OFF! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6593986/369cdb27ca519a7bf9fb51cfa75957d2d02f3aec.png"]

From all of us at Claymatic Games, thank you so much for your support on our journey - We hope you enjoy Platypus Reclayed - Blast Off! 🚀 🧡



Share your Platypus Adventures with us across our socials:

Discord • YouTube • Instagram • TikTok • Bluesky • Twitter
